all_papers.title: Aneuploidy selects for the acquisition of driver genes in breast cancer
all_papers.summary: Screening of chromosome arm-level aneuploidies uncovers that these alterations select for specific basal-like breast cancer driver genes, including PLGRKT, an oncogene whose tumour-promoting activity is associated with highly stress-resistant mitochondria and enhanced detoxification of reactive oxygen species

all_papers.llm_research_question_zh: 对染色体臂水平非整倍性的检测发现，这类遗传变异会选择某些特定的、与基底细胞癌发生相关的驱动基因；其中就包括PLGRKT这种致癌基因——它的促肿瘤作用与线粒体具有极强的抗应激能力以及其能够更有效地清除活性氧有关。
